title: Create a Multi-Channel Automation with Zapier
learning_outcomes: Connect multiple apps using Zapier triggers and actions
Map data fields correctly between different platforms
Build multi-step automations that handle lead capture
Test automations and troubleshoot data flow issues
Document automation workflows for team reference

steps.title: Set Up Zapier Account and Connect Apps
steps.instructions:
1. Go to zapier.com and sign up for a free account.
2. Complete the onboarding wizard — select 'Marketing' as your use case.
3. Connect the following apps to Zapier (go to My Apps > Add Connection):
   - Google Account (for Forms and Sheets)
   - MailerLite (use API key from Settings > Integrations > API)
   - Slack (create a free workspace at slack.com first if you don't have one — name it 'TechPath Marketing Team')
4. In Slack, create a channel called '#new-leads'.
5. Create a Google Sheet called 'Lead Tracker - TechPath' with columns: Timestamp, Full Name, Email, Phone, Source, Interest, Status.
6. Create a Google Form called 'TechPath Course Interest Form' with fields:
   - Full Name (short answer, required)
   - Email Address (short answer, required)
   - Phone Number (short answer, required)
   - How did you hear about us? (dropdown: Google Search, Instagram, YouTube, Friend's Referral, WhatsApp)
   - Which course interests you? (dropdown: Digital Marketing, Web Development, Data Analytics, UI/UX Design)
7. Verify all 4 apps show 'Connected' status in Zapier.
8. Take a screenshot showing all connected apps.

steps.title: Build Zap 1: Form Submission to Email List
steps.instructions:
1. Click 'Create Zap' in Zapier.
2. Set Trigger:
   - App: Google Forms
   - Event: New Response in Spreadsheet
   - Account: Select your Google account
   - Form: Select 'TechPath Course Interest Form'
   - Test trigger: Submit a test response in your Google Form first, then click 'Test trigger' in Zapier
3. Set Action:
   - App: MailerLite
   - Event: Add Subscriber to Group
   - Account: Select your MailerLite account
   - Group: Select 'Welcome Sequence Leads' (from Lab A)
   - Map fields:
     * Email: Map to form's Email field
     * Name: Map to form's Full Name field
   - Add custom field: Map 'Interest' to Course Interest answer
4. Test the action — verify the subscriber appears in MailerLite.
5. Name this Zap: 'Form to MailerLite - Lead Capture'.
6. Keep the Zap OFF for now (we will turn it on after building all Zaps).
7. Take a screenshot of the completed Zap with test success.

steps.title: Build Zap 2: New Subscriber to Welcome Email
steps.instructions:
1. Create a new Zap.
2. Set Trigger:
   - App: MailerLite
   - Event: Subscriber Added to Group
   - Account: Select your MailerLite account
   - Group: 'Welcome Sequence Leads'
   - Test trigger: Use the subscriber you added in the previous step
3. Set Action:
   - App: MailerLite
   - Event: Send Campaign to Group (or use 'Add to Automation' if available)
   - If 'Send Campaign' is not available on free tier, use this alternative:
     * App: Email by Zapier (built-in)
     * Event: Send Outbound Email
     * To: Map to subscriber's email
     * Subject: 'Welcome to TechPath Academy, {{name}}!'
     * Body: Write a brief welcome message (3-4 sentences welcoming them and telling them to check their inbox for the toolkit)
4. Test the action — check if the email sends correctly.
5. Name this Zap: 'New Subscriber - Send Welcome'.
6. Take a screenshot showing the Zap trigger and action configured.
7. Note: If you set up the automation in Lab A correctly, MailerLite will already send the welcome sequence. This Zap adds an immediate confirmation email as a backup.

steps.title: Build Zap 3: Email Open to CRM Update
steps.instructions:
1. Create a new Zap.
2. Set Trigger:
   - App: Google Forms
   - Event: New Response in Spreadsheet (same form as Zap 1)
   - This simulates the CRM update flow — in a real setup, you would trigger on email opens
3. Set Action 1:
   - App: Google Sheets
   - Event: Create Spreadsheet Row
   - Account: Select your Google account
   - Spreadsheet: 'Lead Tracker - TechPath'
   - Sheet: Sheet1
   - Map columns:
     * Timestamp: Use Zap's built-in timestamp
     * Full Name: Map from form
     * Email: Map from form
     * Phone: Map from form
     * Source: Map from 'How did you hear about us?'
     * Interest: Map from 'Which course interests you?'
     * Status: Type 'New Lead' (static value)
4. Add Action 2 (click the + button):
   - App: Slack
   - Event: Send Channel Message
   - Channel: #new-leads
   - Message Text: '🆕 *New Lead Alert!*
     Name: {{Full Name}}
     Email: {{Email}}
     Phone: {{Phone}}
     Source: {{Source}}
     Interest: {{Interest}}
     Time: {{Timestamp}}'
5. Test both actions.
6. Name this Zap: 'Form to Sheet + Slack Notification'.
7. Take screenshots of: Google Sheet with new row, Slack message received.

steps.title: Test All Zaps End-to-End and Document
steps.instructions:
1. Turn ON all three Zaps.
2. Submit 3 different test entries through your Google Form using different data:
   - Test 1: Rahul Verma, Google Search, Digital Marketing
   - Test 2: Priya Nair, Instagram, Web Development
   - Test 3: Amit Saxena, Friend's Referral, Data Analytics
3. Wait 2-3 minutes for Zaps to process.
4. Verify the complete flow for each submission:
   - [ ] Contact added to MailerLite group (check subscriber list)
   - [ ] Welcome email received (check test inboxes or MailerLite activity)
   - [ ] Row added to Google Sheet (check the spreadsheet)
   - [ ] Slack notification posted (check #new-leads channel)
5. Go to Zapier > Zap History and verify all tasks show 'Success' status.
6. Take screenshots of:
   - Zap History showing all successful runs
   - Google Sheet with all 3 entries
   - Slack channel with all 3 notifications
   - MailerLite subscriber list with new contacts
7. Create a simple documentation (in Google Doc or Notion):
   - Title: 'Lead Automation Workflow Documentation'
   - Include: Workflow diagram (draw a simple flowchart), what each Zap does, how to troubleshoot if something breaks, and any limitations of the free tier.
8. Write a reflection (3-4 sentences): How would you improve this automation for a real business? What additional steps would you add?
